html:
SMTO-PRL-0004 — This step is no longer waiting for that answer

GUID: 177a528d-cb3d-45e6-b5f7-4c1a9d994aff
Slug: activity-input-expired
Domain: PRL · Subsystem: prl

What happened

  • Your reply or approval was for a question this step isn't asking any more. The task may have stopped or finished, or the question changed. Your reply wasn't used.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Reload the page and reopen the conversation. This shows whether the step is still waiting and what it is asking now.
  2. Open the task's Activities section. If the step still shows Provide input or Review approval, read the current question and respond to that. SMTO only accepts a reply that matches the question the step is asking now.
  3. If the task has stopped or finished, send a new message saying what you want SMTO to do. A stopped or finished task can't take any more replies.

What success looks like

  • Your reply is accepted and the step moves on, or the step no longer asks for input.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't keep resending your old reply; it was meant for a question that has changed.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Activity input was rejected because the run is stopping or has finished, or the action or operation_id no longer matches the activity's current waiting_user or waiting_approval request.

What this means

  • Activity input arrives after Stop/terminal run state, or its action/operation_id no longer matches the pending activity request. Activity ownership, preflight and durable receipts determine admission and effect certainty. Rejected new work does not erase prior child effects; recovery and diagnostics never replay an unknown operation.

Why this can happen

  • Activity input arrives after Stop/terminal run state, or its action/operation_id no longer matches the pending activity request.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare current run state, requested action and exact operation identity before supplying input again.

How to fix it

  • Reload the run snapshot and resubmit only if the activity is still waiting_user (answer) or waiting_approval (approve) with the same operation_id. Input after Stop or a finished run status is always rejected.
  • Refresh the current activity and respond only if it still shows the same pending question.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • Input is accepted only for the current matching pending question.

What not to do

  • Do not submit a stale identifier or revision after another actor changed the resource.

Technical notes

  • Activity ownership, preflight and durable receipts determine admission and effect certainty. Rejected new work does not erase prior child effects; recovery and diagnostics never replay an unknown operation.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
